title: Michigan Stadium
content: Back to text-based tour homepage. Part of the  Athletics  tour. # Michigan Stadium. 1201 S Main St, Ann Arbor, MI 48109. Michigan Stadium, the "Big House," home of Michigan Football, is the largest stadium in the United States with a capacity of 109,901. Built in 1927, "The Big House" is the largest stadium in America and the third-largest in the world. A crowd gathered outside of the gates of Michigan Stadium. Since 1975, more than 100,000 fans have packed the stadium for each non-pandemic home game. A full stadium with large American flags on the field. Flyovers are a popular feature of the games at Michigan Stadium. The Michigan Wolverines entering Michigan Stadium under a banner that says Go Blue, M Club Supports You. Michigan's football program started in 1879, only 10 years after college football itself began.
